tool_input.description: Re-run report on fresh and test databases

result:
Authors can now schedule a post to publish later. `bun run typecheck`, `bun test` (10 tests, 8 of them new) and the full `bunx guren gate` all pass. I also ran `bun run console posts:scheduled` against the test database and against a brand-new one; both times stdout held only the report lines.

- **Storage:** `posts` has a new nullable `published_at` text column (`db/schema.ts`, plus a generated migration). Dates are always saved in ISO UTC form (e.g. `2026-10-01T09:00:00.000Z`), so comparing the stored text also compares the times.
- **Forms:** `publishAt` is optional on create and edit. Absent or `null` means publish now. A non-date such as `next tuesday` gets the same 422 response as an empty title, and nothing is saved. The New and Edit pages have a "Publish at" date-and-time field that converts the browser's local time to UTC.
- **Who sees what:** `Post.visibleTo(viewerId)` in `app/Models/Post.ts` returns posts with no date, a past date, or the viewer as author. The posts list and search use it. A post's page returns 404 to anyone but the author while it is scheduled. Nothing needs to run when the time arrives.
- **Author view:** a scheduled post carries `publishedAt` on its `post` prop. The list and the post page show a "Scheduled · goes live …" line.
- **Report:** `posts:scheduled` prints `id<TAB>title<TAB>published_at` per scheduled post, soonest first, and exits 0. It prints nothing when nothing is scheduled.

Beyond the request:
- **Home page:** its "latest posts" block now hides scheduled posts from everyone, including the author.
- **`bin/console.ts` change:** on a fresh database, the startup "Applied N migration(s)" notice went to stdout and would have broken the report's output. I now send startup messages to stderr for all console commands.

The report doesn't escape titles, so a title containing a tab or line break would break its line format.

**Summary:** I added a nullable `published_at` column (schema plus migration), an optional `publishAt` field in `app/Http/Validators/PostValidator.ts`, and the `Post.visibleTo()` and `Post.isScheduled()` helpers in `app/Models/Post.ts`. `PostController` uses them for the list, search and post page, and saves the date on create and edit; `HomeController` hides scheduled posts. `PostResource` now includes `publishedAt`. On the frontend, I added "Publish at" fields to the New and Edit pages, scheduled labels to the Index and Show pages, and a shared date helper in `resources/js/components/publishAt.ts`. The `posts:scheduled` report is in `app/Console/Commands/ListScheduledPostsCommand.ts` and is registered in `src/console.ts`. `bin/console.ts` now sends startup messages to stderr, and `tests/ScheduledPosts.test.ts` covers visibility, date validation, publishing once the time passes, and the report.
